# mvstmt: extract code with chan, map, array, slice types
mv x.go:/code/+0,/end/-0 NewFunc
-- x.go --
package m

func F() {
	// code
	ch := make(chan int)
	m := make(map[string]int)
	a := [3]int{1, 2, 3}
	s := []int{1, 2, 3}
	_ = ch
	_ = m
	_ = a
	_ = s
	// end
}
-- stdout --
